Name: New NPC Yanhe - ENG Translation
Author: 1YuiKurata1
Description:
Hello!
This [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42143?tab=description]mod[/url] was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PearCatfoo?gameId=1303]PearCat[/url] in collaboration with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mofuchenfff]Mufu[/url][/b],  and I’m happy to bring you the English translation.

The current 1.0 beta version includes:
[list=1]
[*]Dialogues for different seasons, weather conditions, and friendship levels.
[*]Independent schedules.
[*]Post-marriage schedules and dialogues.
[*]Special festival interactions.

[/list]Please note that this beta version does not include heart events yet. They will be added in future updates.
I am [b]1YuiKurata1[/b], the English translator for this mod.

If you encounter any mistakes, typos, or bugs in the translation, please create a post to report them. I’ll take care of it as soon as possible.
P.S.: If red text saying [i]"Unrecognizable map file"[/i] appears when installing the mod, don’t worry — it will still work properly.

The map file is currently missing because Yanhe’s exclusive cabin hasn’t been fully completed yet.
It will be added in a later update.
